MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 2/2
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 90
   C. 42
   D. 21

3. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 37
   C. 31.6
   D. 31.7

4. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 1

5. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.7
   D. 19.6

6. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

7. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.7
   C. 33
   D. 27.6

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 66
   C. 22
   D. 34

9. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 9

10. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

11. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 0
   C. 16
   D. 64

12. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 29
   C. 11
   D. 28

13. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 29
   C. 23.7
   D. 23.6

14. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 7
   C. 17
   D. 13

15. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 14

16. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15.6
   D. 15

17. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/4
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/2

18. Solve for x: x + 4 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 11
   D. 14

19. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 24

20. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 8
   D. 24.5

21. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

22. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 24
   D. 11

23. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 8
   C. 16
   D. 17

24. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 24

25. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 40
   C. 13
   D. 3

26. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 36

27. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 11

28. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

29. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

30. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.025

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
